name: King Slime
summon: Use it in any biome, at any time. King Slime also spawns on its own during a Slime Rain.

drops.name: Crown Jewel
drops.effect: Grants +0.5 HP/s life regen and reduces damage-over-time taken by 2 HP/s.

drops.name: Katana
drops.effect: A fast, autoswinging katana.

drops.name: Slimy Saddle
drops.effect: Summons the Slime Mount, which hovers and slams down onto enemies.

drops.name: Slime Gun
drops.effect: Sprays harmless slime - a novelty item that deals no damage.

drops.name: Slime Hook
drops.effect: A single-claw grappling hook with slime-green reach.

drops.name: Ninja Hood
drops.effect: Vanity headpiece from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.name: Ninja Shirt
drops.effect: Vanity shirt from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.name: Ninja Pants
drops.effect: Vanity leggings from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.name: King Slime Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like King Slime's crown and face.

drops.name: Royal Gel
drops.effect: Slimes become friendly and no longer harm you.

blurb: A giant blue slime king and an optional early warm-up before diving into Calamity's own bosses.

summonItem.name: Slime Crown
summonItem.effect: Summons King Slime when used, in any biome at any time.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Desert Scourge
summon: Use it in the Desert or Underground Desert.

drops.name: Sahara Slicers
drops.effect: When swung, a pair of dual daggers rapidly stab in front of the player. Hitting an enemy with one of the daggers will spawn 2 bolts which appear behind the player, up to a maximum of 10.

drops.name: Barinade
drops.effect: Fires two converging high-velocity fin arrows that soar through the air.

drops.name: Sandstream Scepter
drops.effect: Fires an explosive stream of sand that detonates when the projectile expires.

drops.name: Brittle Star Staff
drops.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

drops.name: Scourge of the Desert
drops.effect: When used, it throws a javelin that burrows into tiles and launches itself towards the closest enemy when burrowing through tiles. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and pierce twice.

drops.name: Sand Cloak
drops.effect: Dashing creates a protective sand veil that damages enemies and grants +3 defense and 75% acceleration inside it.

drops.name: Ocean Crest
drops.effect: Recover air while standing still underwater, and 15% increased mining speed while wet.

drops.name: Desert Scourge Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask modeled on the Desert Scourge.

blurb: A colossal sea serpent adapted to the sands, serving as Calamity's intended first boss.

summonItem.name: Desert Medallion
summonItem.effect: Summons the Desert Scourge when used in the Desert; enrages elsewhere. Reusable.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

unlocks: Sandstorms can now occur naturally, and the Sunken Sea opens up - fish there for the Sparkling Empress and Sea Spirit Amulet, and Giant Clams start to spawn. Prism-Backs begin dropping Prism Shards, and Ghost Bells drop Voltaic Jelly.

name: Eye of Cthulhu
summon: Use a Suspicious Looking Eye at night, or spawns naturally on eligible worlds.
blurb: A giant floating eye that splits into servants of Cthulhu as it takes damage.

name: Crabulon
summon: Use the Decapodita Sprout in the Glowing Mushroom biome at any time.

drops.name: Mycelial Claws
drops.effect: A fast autoswinging claw that grants the Mushy buff on hit, boosting life regen.

drops.name: Fungicide
drops.effect: Converts musket balls into fungal rounds that split into spores on impact.

drops.name: Hyphae Rod
drops.effect: Fires a bouncing spore that creates lingering mushroom clouds near the player.

drops.name: Infested Clawmerang
drops.effect: A slow, long-ranged rogue boomerang. Stealth strikes summon homing spores and grant the Mushy buff.

drops.name: Mycoroot
drops.effect: Fires a stream of short-range fungal roots. Stealth strikes burst into an explosion of spores.

drops.name: Puff Shroom
drops.effect: Summons a mushroom warrior minion that fights for you and grants the Puff Warrior buff.

drops.name: Mushroom Plasma Root
drops.effect: Permanent power-up. Increases the duration of Rage Mode by 1 second when consumed.

drops.name: Crabulon Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Crabulon's fungal crab head.

blurb: A towering fungal crab that showers the arena with spores and mushroom crabs.

summonItem.name: Decapodita Sprout
summonItem.effect: Summons Crabulon when used inside the Glowing Mushroom biome.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Eater of Worlds
summon: Use Worm Food in the Corruption, or break three Shadow Orbs.
blurb: A massive segmented worm that burrows through the Corruption, splitting when struck.

name: Brain of Cthulhu
summon: Use a Bloody Spine in the Crimson, or break three Crimson Hearts.
blurb: The Crimson's pulsing brain that teleports behind a swarm of Creepers.

name: The Hive Mind
summon: Kill a Hive Tumor in the Corruption, or craft and use a Teratoma.
blurb: Calamity's Corruption boss, a shade-slinging mass that shifts from stationary to a mobile second phase.

name: The Perforators
summon: Kill a Perforator Cyst in the Crimson, or craft and use Bloody Worm Food.
blurb: Calamity's Crimson boss: a hive that unleashes escalating blood-worms of gore.

name: Queen Bee
summon: Break a Larva in a Jungle Bee Hive or use Abeemination.
blurb: The Jungle's giant bee that dashes and rains stingers, dropping bee-themed gear.

name: Skeletron
summon: Speak to the Old Man at the Dungeon entrance at night.
blurb: The Dungeon's cursed guardian whose spinning skull and hands must fall before dawn.

name: Deerclops
summon: Use a Deer Thing in a Snow biome at night, or spawns during a Blizzard.
blurb: A one-eyed frozen cyclops from Don't Starve that slams shadow hands across the snow.

name: The Slime God
summon: Use the Overloaded Sludge anywhere.
blurb: A tri-part gelatinous god of two paladins and an invulnerable core, Calamity's final pre-hardmode gate.

name: Wall of Flesh
summon: Drop a Guide Voodoo Doll into lava in the Underworld.
blurb: The Underworld's fleshy wall whose defeat shatters the world into Hardmode.

name: Queen Slime
summon: Use a Gelatin Crystal in the Hallow.
blurb: An optional early-Hardmode Hallow boss that bounces and spawns crystal slimes, offering strong early minion and summoner gear.

name: Cryogen
summon: Use a Cryo Key in the Snow or Ice biome.
blurb: A sealed magical guardian with an icy-blue aesthetic that cycles through multiphase projectile barrages, the intended first Calamity Hardmode boss.

name: The Twins
summon: Use a Mechanical Eye at night.
blurb: A vanilla mechanical boss of twin mechanical eyes, one of the three mechs that must fall to advance progression.

name: Aquatic Scourge
summon: Use a Seafood item at any time.
blurb: A mutated sea serpent of the Sulphurous Sea with acidic toxin attacks and murky teal coloration.

name: The Destroyer
summon: Use a Mechanical Worm at night.
blurb: A vanilla mechanical worm bristling with lasers and probes, one of the required Hardmode mechs.

name: Brimstone Elemental
summon: Use a Charred Idol in the Brimstone Crag.
blurb: A fiery red-and-orange elemental of the Brimstone Crag that escalates aggression across three attack phases.

name: Skeletron Prime
summon: Use a Mechanical Skull at night.
blurb: A vanilla mechanical skull with spinning limbs, the last of the three mechs before Plantera opens up.

name: Calamitas Clone
summon: Use an Eye of Desolation at night.
blurb: A brimstone-themed clone that chases the player while summoning minion constructs, gating post-mech Calamity gear.

name: Plantera
summon: Break a Plantera's Bulb in the Underground Jungle.
blurb: The vanilla jungle boss whose defeat unlocks the Jungle Temple and much of the late Hardmode roadmap.

name: Leviathan and Anahita
summon: Use a Naiad's Warhorn item in the Ocean biome.
blurb: An ocean-themed duo pairing a water elemental with a massive marine reptile that unleash ice and meteor attacks.

name: Astrum Aureus
summon: Use an Astral Chunk in the Astral Infection biome.
blurb: A mechanical construct corrupted by the Astral Infection, leaping and firing laser spreads with a golden cosmic sheen.

name: Golem
summon: Use a Lihzahrd Power Cell at the altar in the Jungle Temple.
blurb: The vanilla Lihzahrd Temple guardian whose defeat opens post-Golem progression.

name: Duke Fishron
summon: Fish with Truffle Worm bait in the Ocean biome.
blurb: An optional vanilla pigron-dragon of the Ocean, dangerous but dropping some of the best endgame-adjacent weapons.

name: The Plaguebringer Goliath
summon: Use an Abombination item in the Jungle or Underground Jungle.
blurb: A Draedon-built plague creature of biological control, sickly green and bristling with toxic missile and drone attacks.

name: Empress of Light
summon: Kill a Prismatic Lacewing at night in the Hallow.
blurb: An optional prismatic Hallow fairy whose dazzling rainbow attack patterns reward precise dodging with elite gear.

name: Ravager
summon: Use a Death Whistle item.
blurb: A grotesque grounded flesh construct that hops and hurls its own dismembered limbs across the surface battlefield.

name: Lunatic Cultist
summon: Kill the cultists at the Dungeon entrance after Golem.
blurb: The vanilla robed cultist whose defeat triggers the Lunar Events and the Celestial Pillars.

name: Astrum Deus
summon: Use a Titan Heart or Starcore at the Astral Beacon at night.
blurb: A celestial burrowing worm with shifting blue-and-orange astral phases, the intended final pre-Moon Lord Calamity boss.

name: Moon Lord
summon: Defeat all four Celestial Pillars, or use a Celestial Sigil.
blurb: The vanilla final boss and the climax of Hardmode, whose defeat opens the door to Calamity's post-Moon Lord content.

name: Profaned Guardians
summon: Use a Profaned Shard in the Underworld or the Hallow
blurb: A trio of holy fire guardians that gatekeep Providence, dropping the Profaned Core needed to summon her.

name: The Dragonfolly
summon: Use Exotic Pheromones in the Jungle
blurb: An optional cybernetic bird-of-prey, a faster and deadlier echo of the Bumblebirds, dropping Effulgent Feathers for progression gear.

name: Providence, the Profaned Goddess
summon: Use a Profaned Core in the Hallow or the Underworld
blurb: The radiant goddess of the Profaned flame, the first major Post-Moon Lord wall and the source of the Mark that unlocks the Sentinels.

name: Storm Weaver
summon: Use the Mark of Providence while in the sky
blurb: A colossal electric serpent and one of the three Sentinels of the Devourer, fought high in the sky.

name: Ceaseless Void
summon: Use the Mark of Providence while in the Dungeon
blurb: A tear in reality flanked by orbiting Dark Energies, a Sentinel of the Devourer fought within the Dungeon.

name: Signus, Envoy of the Devourer
summon: Use the Mark of Providence while in the Underworld
blurb: A shadowy assassin Sentinel of the Devourer that drops Twisting Nether used to craft the Cosmic Worm.

name: Polterghast
summon: Kill 30 Phantom Spirits or use the Necroplasmic Beacon in the Dungeon
blurb: A tormented mass of Dungeon souls that awakened from the necromantic energy, gating access to the deeper abyss.

name: The Old Duke
summon: Complete the Acid Rain event or fish with a Bloodworm in the Sulphurous Sea
blurb: An optional mutated Duke Fishron of the Sulphurous Sea, unleashed at the climax of the tier-3 Acid Rain event.

name: The Devourer of Gods
summon: Use a Cosmic Worm anywhere at any time
blurb: The god-eating cosmic serpent and Calamity's signature superboss, a brutal endgame gate that tears through dimensions.

name: Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
summon: Use a Blessed Phoenix Egg anywhere at any time
blurb: The immortal jungle dragon and Yharim's loyal guardian, a fiery two-phase gauntlet before the final trials.

name: Exo Mechs
summon: Press the Contact button on a fully completed Codebreaker
blurb: Draedon's ultimate war machines - Ares, Thanatos, and Artemis & Apollo - fought together as one of the two final bosses.

name: Supreme Witch, Calamitas
summon: Interact with an Altar of the Accursed using Ashes of Calamity or a Ceremonial Urn
blurb: The brimstone witch and Calamity's true final boss, an unrelenting bullet-hell duel that caps the mod's progression.
